description: Browse or search administrator-curated public findings with their original evidence, source details, and discussion links. Curation means worth surfacing; it does not mean independently verified. Omit q to browse, or filter by words, topic, or language. Results are read-only public data.

cursor.description: pagination cursor returned by a previous findings call

language.description: optional language code such as en or pt-br

q.description: optional search words to find curated public findings; omit to browse the feed

name: findings
